outcome: labor intervention rates (induction of labor by oxytocin, artificial rupture of membranes, lateral episiotomy, conversion to cesarean section)
cohort: Low-risk nulliparous women with a singleton, full-term fetus in cephalic presentation entering spontaneous labor at a specialized obstetric hospital in China.
finding: The WHO partograph was associated with significantly higher rates of labor interventions, while Zhang's guideline resulted in higher rates of forceps-assisted vaginal deliveries and postpartum hemorrhage, but a lower incidence of birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: The WHO partograph was linked to increased labor interventions including conversion to cesarean section, while Zhang's guideline resulted in higher rates of forceps-assisted vaginal deliveries.
